headline: The counties with the most hiring. Salaries reach 6,500 lei net
summary: Romania's labour market remains concentrated in the largest urban centres, with nearly 150,000 jobs posted since the start of the year. Top-paying roles reach 6,500 lei net per month.
why: Labour market data show where demand for workers is concentrated, which matters for wage inflation, regional investment and consumer spending.
